attributes.title: Midwest Dental Assembly 2027
attributes.summary:
The Indiana Dental Association's Midwest Dental Assembly 2027 takes place April 21 to 24, 2027, in downtown Indianapolis. The meeting combines CE sessions, a vendor marketplace and social events for dentists and their teams.

The 2027 meeting is hosted at the Indianapolis Marriott Downtown, across from the Indiana Convention Center. Registration costs $400 for IDA member dentists and $600 for non-member dentists; hygienists, assistants and other team members pay $150. The hotel rate is $219 per night if booked by March 20, 2027. CE courses run on Thursday and Friday; the total number of CE hours is not published yet. The IDA is an ADA CERP recognized provider.
